component.name: CompTIA Linux+ Study Trainer
component.summary: Interactive CompTIA Linux+ (XK0-006 / V8) study trainer and Bash lab sandbox

description.p: Practice CompTIA Linux+ (XK0-006 / V8) exam scenarios in Multiple Choice, Exact Command Entry, and hands-on Bash Sandbox Labs with real filesystem verification.
Includes Rich Terminal CLI mode, a themed Web/Desktop GUI (OSRS, Cyberpunk, and Ocarina of Time), and cross-platform sandbox execution.
